messages:
Lena: Quick sync — we need to finalize exporter schema + backfill window for the new routing/quota dashboards. Runtime will emit per-route queue_latency_ns, route_capacity_util, and routed_request_count. What aggregation levels do we need?

Raj: From runtime side we can emit 1s counters and a 1s latency histogram per-route and per-tenant. Aggregation job can roll that to 1m and 5m windows.

Maya: Dashboard UX expects 1m and 1h views for the top-level panels. If exporters send 1s, 1m aggregation is fine. Backfill: product asked for 90d for trend comparisons — is that realistic cost-wise?

Chris: Storage cost will jump if we backfill full-res 1m for 90d. Proposal: backfill 30d at 1m, keep 90d as 1h downsampled aggregates, and keep 365d as monthly summaries. That cuts storage and still satisfies trend queries.

Tess: SRE perspective: keep raw 1s/1m for 7d for incident investigations, 30d 1m for runbooks, 90d 1h for trends, 365d 1d for long-term signals. Also we need rollout_id and canary tags on metrics for debugging.

Raj: Agree on labels. We'll add: tenant, route, model_variant, rollout_id. Example exporter snippet: ```yaml
metrics:
  - name: route_queue_latency_ns
    type: histogram
    labels: [tenant, route, rollout_id, model_variant]
  - name: route_capacity_util
    type: gauge
    labels: [tenant, route]
  - name: routed_request_count
    type: counter
    labels: [tenant, route, model_variant]
```

Maya: For the aggregation job, can we run daily parallel backfills (windowed) so we don't saturate DB? We want ability to rerun partial ranges.

Sam: Yes — we'll implement a windowed backfill runner that picks non-overlapping 6h windows and parallelizes up to N workers. We'll include a resume token so retries are cheap. I can own orchestration.

Evan: Product: 30d backfill is acceptable if we expose 90d via 1h downsampled views. Also want a regression alert using a 7d sliding baseline.

Lena: Timeline check — can we get schema PR + dashboards skeleton by EOD Fri, exporter feature-flag rollout to staging Monday, and backfill kick-off Tuesday? :eyes:

Chris: Ops note — exporter write throughput needs quota. Recommend per-host burst 1k metrics/sec, global ingest quota 100k/s. I'll file infra ticket after we lock schema.

deploy-bot: automated: exporter branch deployed to staging (sha: abc123) — metrics endpoint available at /metrics/staging.

Tess: I'll add SLO/trace overlays to the dashboard template and a canary toggle so oncall can flip to raw traces quickly.

Sam: I'll open the backfill job repo and draft the orchestration playbook. Need the final label list and retention table to wire into the job.

Lena: Thanks all. I'll open a small RFC with the retention tiers we agreed (7d raw, 30d 1m, 90d 1h, 365d 1d) + exporter schema and assign PRs. Please add any objections here otherwise I'll proceed. :thumbsup:
